summary: Rename the existing Crown Castle Small Cells Solutions record to Arium Networks and retain the Crown Castle names as predecessor aliases. The EQT Active Core Infrastructure I acquisition legally closed on May 1, 2026 through Small Cells HoldCo Inc.; Arium Networks LLC is the public-facing legal entity. Nested post-close interests identify several co-investors but do not disclose one comparable EQT stake, and Crown Castle's fiber business sold separately to Zayo. EQT still lists Arium as current and no later direct exit or pending transaction was found.
